statusDetail: The entry URL is protected by a Cloudflare managed challenge that returned HTTP 403 to both Chrome and raw crawler requests. No target-site archetype could be reached, so all 58 atomic checks are blocked and no quality verdict or score is published.

page.notes: The rendered document was Cloudflare’s “Just a moment...” challenge. The site architecture and page templates could not be established. Homepage-only coverage was not silently assumed.

artifacts.caption: Desktop entry page showing the Cloudflare security verification wall.
Mobile entry page showing the same Cloudflare security verification wall.
Rendered DOM and styles belong to the Cloudflare challenge, not the target product UI.
Recon probe records title “Just a moment...” and no usable internal links from the challenged page.
Headers observed for the challenge response; not treated as target application evidence.
Raw crawler fetch returned HTTP 403 and zero target-content coverage.
